title: Amazon Bedrock supports SpaceXAI Grok 4.6
hook: What capabilities does SpaceXAI Grok 4.6 bring to Amazon Bedrock?

back.lead: SpaceXAI Grok 4.6 is now available on Amazon Bedrock, offering a 500K context window and configurable reasoning efforts (low, medium, high, xhigh). The model is built for long-running agents and ambitious interactive and visual work.
back.hookline: SpaceXAI's flagship model with a focus on staying with complex tasks across many steps.
